scope: Reproduce and repair stale provider state and obsolete callbacks across explicit stop/start and interrupted lifecycle operations. Preserve freshness thresholds, same-session historical semantics and protected exit behavior.
design: Clear session subscriptions, retired symbols, bars, quotes and all freshness timestamps at explicit stop/new session.
Bind transport callbacks to provider generation and stream identity; accept only current-session subscribed symbols.
Serialize lifecycle/transport changes and invalidate callbacks before awaiting shutdown; discard obsolete asynchronous prefill/subscription/start/reconnect continuations.
Retain stream reference when disconnect fails, so retries cannot replace an unclosed transport; normal reconnect retains stale evidence and requires new actual bars for recovery.
tests: Real provider stop/start with changed symbols drops prior buffer/quote/freshness inventory.
Captured old bar/quote callbacks cannot write while stopped, after restart, or for reused symbols.
Failed connect/bar/quote subscription clears all session state, preserves failed disconnect reference and allows safe retry.
Stop during awaited connect/prefill/subscription/reconnect cannot resurrect old state or launch a replacement connection early.
Same-session recovery keeps actual stale timestamps; old generation callbacks cannot recover it and new advancing bar can.
Existing provider/freshness/scanner and real stale EOD regression suites remain green.
constraints: No runtime/network/broker/model/state access or installed changes.
No threshold/feed/strategy/120-second guard changes; no active freeze/cutoff writes.
No commits; root owns candidate freeze update, full safety/replay pack, snapshots, docs/workflow and CI.
